info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Relations Regulatory Authorities API
info.description: The Corporate Relations Regulatory Authorities API provides access to information related to various regulatory authorities governing corporate banking activities. This API enables users to retrieve details about specific regulatory agencies based on provided parameters. Typical consumers include banking institutions, compliance teams, and corporate legal departments seeking to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their regulatory research and maintain up-to-date records of the authorities that oversee their corporate relations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific regulatory authority identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). Use this endpoint to gather insights into the regulatory framework associated with corporate relations.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving information about regulatory authorities for the specified corporate relations. This object must contain valid JSON structure as defined in the schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested regulatory authority details.
